noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

image.description: Path to image used by UI element.

show.description:
Expose this property or function in the UI as though it were a field. This only works for methods which can be
called with no arguments.

hide.description: Exclude this field, property, or method from UI display. Overrides {@link #show} if both are specified.

align.description:
Force the alignment of the element. If not specified, numeric values are typically right-aligned and others
are left-aligned.

label.description: Custom display label. If not specified, the field or method name is used.

title:
Define extended UI attributes on types, fields, and methods. Provides display hints for any UI context including
grids, forms, and other visualizations.
name: Ann.Ui
